Name: DE-AdditionalInformation
Description: Extracts the Additional Information (to be filtered by document where used)
Statement:
select  df.ColumnName, 
        df.[Order] as [Order], 
        df.MultipleSelection, 
        df.DataType,
        df.DatabaseName,
        df.Lookup, 
        df.LookupType,
        df.LookupValues,
        df.LookupTable,
        df.LookupView,
        sv.Name as LookupViewName,
        q.Name as LookupQuery,
        df.LookupFieldId,
        df.LookupFieldName,
        edq.Name as EditorLookupQueryName,
        edqbk.Name as EditorLookupQueryByKeyName,
        d.Name as DocumentName,
        (select rr.Name from SkillRoles rr where rr.Oid = df.ReadRole) as ReadRole,
        (select sr.Name from SkillRoles sr where sr.Oid = df.SaveRole) as SaveRole
from    DocumentUserField df
            left outer join Query q on q.Oid = df.LookupQuery
            left outer join Query edq on edq.Oid = df.EditorLookupQuery
            left outer join Query edqbk on edqbk.Oid = df.EditorLookupQueryByKey
            left outer join SkillView sv on sv.Oid = df.LookupView,
        Document d
where   df.Document = d.Oid
